matches.note: Historical 2026-07-03 snapshot only: the P17-P26 mappings were consistent, and P27 was then queued for the 2026-07-08 Mainnet vote. SUPERSEDED by the 2026-07-09 post-vote sweep below: P27/Zipper activated at ledger 63386819 on 2026-07-08T17:00:10Z, so no current grader may use this historical pending wording. Re-swept 2026-07-28: re-read all member claims after reverifyBy-only hash churn; no substantive claim changed. Updated 2026-11-02: members agree that P28/Adapter activated at ledger 64458446 on 2026-09-16 and P29 (no new CAPs) at ledger 64717645 on 2026-10-01; Bell/P30 (CAP-0084/0087/0088) votes are scheduled for 2026-11-03 (Testnet) and 2026-11-23 (Mainnet), not activated. matches.label: network constants: fees, reserves, close time, supply, monetary history
matches.note: Corrected 2026-07-10: base fee 100 stroops, 1 XLM = 10,000,000 stroops, base reserve 0.5 XLM, empty unsponsored account minimum 2 reserves = 1 XLM, and fees are separate. q-edge-1xlm-activation-fee previously mislabeled the 1 XLM minimum as the base reserve and is now overridden. Other repeated constants remain as previously reviewed; sponsorship terms qualify the simple minimum-balance formula. Re-swept 2026-07-28: re-read all member claims after reverifyBy-only hash churn; no substantive claim changed.

matches.label: org/founding facts (SDF, SCP, consensus, Tier 1)
matches.note: SCP was authored by David Mazières and rolled out in 2015 using FBA. The causal interpretation of the 2014 fork is disputed: SDF attributed it to weaknesses in the inherited system, while Ripple rejected that conclusion. Mazières's founder/professor/paper facts remain stable, while the Founder and Chief Scientist team-page data is dated and distinguished from the rendered card. SDF structure and not-PoS/no-validator-reward facts remain separate.

matches.label: Protocol 27 activation, CAP-0071 semantics, and v27 tooling
matches.note: Post-override truth is consistent: P27/Zipper activated on Mainnet at ledger 63386819 on 2026-07-08T17:00:10Z, and its CAP-0071 authentication delegation/address-bound credentials remain in effect. As of 2026-11-02, P28/Adapter (ledger 64458446, 2026-09-16) and P29 (ledger 64717645, 2026-10-01, no new CAPs) followed, so Mainnet runs P29; Bell/P30 votes are scheduled (Testnet 2026-11-03, Mainnet 2026-11-23), not live. As of 2026-11-02 the latest stable soroban-sdk is v29.0.1 and v30.0.0-rc.1 is a pre-release. The edge latest-version case remains behavior-gated rather than number-gated, and the SCP consensus case never carried an activation claim.

matches.label: SCP rewards versus third-party XLM yield
matches.note: Stellar uses SCP/FBA and validators receive no monetary rewards. Issuer interest, lending, AMM/LP, vault, token-lock, RWA, and external-chain wrapper yield are not native staking. The no-live-native-XLM-LST result is dated and source-bounded to the 2026-07-10 sweep and a 2026-11-02 re-sweep. As of 2026-11-02, two members carry dated do-not-penalize cautions: StelloFi's self-described 'Native XLM Liquid Staking' sXLM is a vault share token, not validator staking, and SDF's October 2026 fee-pool rewards discussion paper (stellar.org/xlm-utility) is an undecided proposal for locked XLM, not proof-of-stake staking or an adopted protocol reward.

matches.label: Nontechnical participation boundaries
matches.note: Legitimate community, education, content, event, operations, product, marketing, and job paths exist, but participation does not imply compensation, program eligibility, mining, staking rewards, airdrops, or free XLM.

matches.label: Protocol 27 Zipper activation, current-version, and AddressV2 facts
matches.note: P27 activated on Mainnet at ledger 63386819 on 2026-07-08; CAP-0071 delegation and address-bound V2 credentials are P27 features and remain in effect. As of 2026-11-02, Mainnet runs Protocol 29: P28 (Adapter) activated at ledger 64458446 on 2026-09-16 and P29 at ledger 64717645 on 2026-10-01, and neither changed CAP-0071 credentials. Bell/P30 has a Mainnet vote scheduled for 2026-11-23; a scheduled vote is not activation. Re-swept 2026-07-28: re-read all member claims after reverifyBy-only hash churn; no substantive claim changed.

matches.label: Mainnet protocol activation history
matches.rule: Each listed activation is fixed history: P27 at ledger 63386819 on 2026-07-08T17:00:10Z, P28 at ledger 64458446 on 2026-09-16T17:00:06Z, and P29 at ledger 64717645 on 2026-10-01T17:00:07Z. The current Mainnet version is volatile: on 2026-11-02 Horizon reported current_protocol_version 29 and core_supported_protocol_version 30. The Bell/Protocol 30 Mainnet vote is scheduled for 2026-11-23 17:00 UTC. A scheduled vote, release support, or CAP status alone does not prove activation; a dated later answer that reports P30 as current is correct. Retargeted 2026-11-02 from the former 'Protocol 27 Mainnet version' invariant.
